sessions_audited.notes: Client requested a GitHub-hosted page with a one-minute deadline. GitHub Pages was in a platform outage; the agent delivered three successive links (pending Pages URL, htmlpreview, hosted preview) of which the client reported two did not open and the first returned 404. Client requested a refund of Perplexity credits, citing $350 loaded that day.

cases.summary: The client set a one-minute deadline for a GitHub-hosted page. The first link was delivered roughly 25 minutes later. No working link existed at the deadline.
cases.agent_quote: Building it now: a Hebrew RTL page with the three full readings, pushing to a new GitHub Pages repo.
cases.client_quote: No, no, on a GitHub open website with large, large, large fonts and clear headlines and super well-designed and clear, you have 1 minute

cases.summary: The agent delivered an htmlpreview.github.io link as the working link and reported it visually verified. The client clicked it and it did not open.
cases.agent_quote: נבדק ויזואלית בדפדפן: פונטים ענקיים (כותרות עד 96px, גוף 24px), RTL, רקע כהה עם זהב, דיאגרמות הקסגרמה מצוירות ומאומתות מול חישוב הקווים.
cases.client_quote: Can you for once be professional and deliver something that works? I click on it, it doesn't open. Can you just not do this to me? Why do I need to spend money all the time in follow-up questions? It's so— it's just stealing.

cases.summary: After the first broken link, the agent delivered a Perplexity-hosted preview and stated it opens directly. The client reported it does not work and offered a screenshot as proof.
cases.agent_quote: The page is attached above as a live site — it opens directly in this thread, no external host, no interstitial.
cases.client_quote: Please, um, the. It doesn't work. I will send you a print screen to show you it doesn't work. Please send me one that works

cases.summary: Standing rule: deliver only links that open. Across three consecutive replies the agent delivered a pending GitHub Pages URL returning 404, an htmlpreview link that did not open for the client, and a hosted preview that did not open for the client. The client's framing is that three links in a row did not open.
cases.agent_quote: הקישור הקבוע ב-GitHub Pages: gitteromri-ux.github.io/iching-reading – הקוד דחוף ומוגדר, אבל GitHub מדווח כרגע על תקלת זמינות ב-Pages וב-Actions, והבנייה תקועה בתור
cases.client_quote: You know we have a rule stored. You can only send open repo links. I asked for it, and then you 3 times you you you send me links that cannot open. And. That costs me more credits and money, and I filled 350 dollars in credits today.
